reviewType: manual visual inspection of actual CI PNGs by root and delegated reviewer; not execution of human UAT cases

screenshots.name: a2-plan-desktop-editor.png
screenshots.observation: Purpose, constraints, two step editors, review date and save controls are legible and within the card; the date control has a visible focus indicator.

screenshots.name: a2-plan-desktop-completed.png
screenshots.observation: The confirmed completion notice, declared done/skipped step states and prepare-another-plan action are visible.

screenshots.name: a2-plan-desktop-conflict-retains-draft.png
screenshots.observation: The newer saved plan and retained local draft are both visible; explicit re-review is offered and save remains disabled until review.

screenshots.name: a2-plan-desktop-replay-after-deletion.png
screenshots.observation: The notice distinguishes the prior request confirmation from the current deleted state; no prior plan content is restored.

screenshots.name: a2-plan-desktop-account-change.png
screenshots.observation: Plan/editor/conversation are absent; the session-change alert and reopening link remain. A pre-existing cosmetic lack of separation before the link is visible.

screenshots.name: a2-plan-mobile-editor.png
screenshots.observation: The two-step editor fits the 390px width; labels and controls are not horizontally cropped and the second title shows focus.

screenshots.name: a2-plan-mobile-completed.png
screenshots.observation: The completion notice, declared done/skipped steps, review date and next action are legible within the card.

screenshots.name: a2-plan-mobile-deleted.png
screenshots.observation: The deletion notice and empty-state action remain, with no deleted plan steps or text.

knownCosmeticObservation.description: The reopening link lacks separation from the preceding full stop.

limitations: Full-page captures retain fixed AppShell elements at the current scroll position and visibly overlay portions of the flattened document; they do not establish obstruction-free controls at every viewport position.
Laboratory root/font shell is substituted as declared in a2-plan-scope.json.
Mobile coverage is Chromium viewport 390x844, not touch, a physical device or Safari.
Eight incomplete color-contrast scans remain; visual inspection does not establish complete WCAG conformance.
The 54 manual UAT cases remain unexecuted.
